Aisha (FinOps): Morning — noticed another jump in GPU spend for us-west-2 overnight. Daily dashboard shows a 38% spike vs yesterday. Anyone tracking abnormal provisioning? :eyes:
Liam (SRE): I saw autoscaler churn around 02:00 UTC, some nodes spun up then drained. Could be scale-threshold thrashing.
Ravi (Infra): Hmm — saw multiple "ProvisionInstance" API retries in the cloud logs at that time. Suspect instance-type fallback triggered (p3 -> p2).
Sana (ML Eng): Per-route cost view shows most of the token spend came from /v1/chat/rerank requests hitting model-x-2b, very high seq lengths.
Aisha (FinOps): Pasting the relevant query snippet from the dashboard so we can correlate: ```sql
SELECT route, model, sum(token_cost) as cost
FROM billing_events
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-17'
GROUP BY route, model
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Liam (SRE): Can you attach the time series? I want to align with node events.
finance-bot: Updated dashboard link: https://redwood-internal/dashboards/finops/daily-burn (last refresh 1775003400)
Ravi (Infra): Copy of cloud API failures (redacted): ```
2026-03-17T02:01:12Z ProvisionInstance failed: InsufficientCapacity
2026-03-17T02:01:18Z ProvisionInstance retry -> fallbackType=p2.large
2026-03-17T02:03:05Z ProvisionInstance success
```
Sana (ML Eng): If we fallback to smaller instances, that can increase token cost if throughput drops and requests queue, or if we spin up extra replicas for latency SLO. Also the reranker route does dense scoring so seq_len ~1024 often.
Aisha (FinOps): The per-model-per-route slice shows "/v1/chat/rerank" + model-x-2b = $3.1k of the $4.2k overnight spike. The rest is normal.
Liam (SRE): Action idea: throttle that route during region capacity pressure and fallback to cheaper model variant. Can we add a routing policy?
Sana (ML Eng): We have model-x-1b as lower-cost alternative but quality differs. We can add a soft fallback: prefer model-x-2b, but if capacity events detected or queue > 300ms, route to 1b.
Ravi (Infra): Also recommend we reserve a small committed capacity profile in us-west-2 for critical routes to avoid InsufficientCapacity during peak nightly batch work. Commitment ask: 4x A100-equivalent for base coverage.
Aisha (FinOps): Can you estimate monthly delta if we commit 4x A100-eq vs current on-demand? Need a quick calc for the exec update.
Liam (SRE): Quick back-of-envelope: current on-demand spike cost for those hours is ~$9k/month attributable to fallback churn and extra replicas. Committing should save ~45% on those hours -> ~$4k/month savings, minus commitment amortization.
Sana (ML Eng): Also we should add a per-route token cap to the reranker to prevent runaway seq lengths from user errors (saw a few requests with seq_len 4096).
Aisha (FinOps): Agreed. Next steps: (1) Ravi to run committed-cost estimate with cloud sales (ETA 24h), (2) Liam to draft autoscaler guardrails (ETA 48h), (3) Sana to add fallback policy + per-route token cap (ETA 72h).
Ravi (Infra): I'll open a ticket for the cloud commits and cc @aisha. Also will request quota increase/soft-reservation while commit is negotiated.
Liam (SRE): I'll add an alert to the FinOps dashboard for "instance fallback events" and correlate to per-route cost spikes.
Sana (ML Eng): Implementing soft fallback as a config flag on the router; will test on staging today.
Aisha (FinOps): Thanks team. Please paste PRs/tickets here so I can track cost impact. I'll update the daily burn deck with preliminary numbers tomorrow. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: routing-policy-v0.3 -> staging (sha: ab12cd)
Aisha (FinOps): Filing summary for exec: "Unexpected capacity fallbacks in us-west-2 caused heavy reranker usage to balloon overnight. Proposed mitigations: small reserved commitment + autoscaler tuning + route-level fallbacks and token caps."
Liam (SRE): Sounds good. If finance wants a sensitivity table for committed sizes (2x/4x/8x) I can produce it by EOD.
Aisha (FinOps): Please do. End-of-thread update expected tomorrow 14:00 UTC.
